remarks: Welcome to 2 Snapdragon, Irvine — A Private Retreat in the Heart of Irvine    Discover the charm of single-level living in this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom townhome, offering the comfort, space, and privacy of a single-family home. Located on a quiet street, this inviting residence features soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, thoughtful upgrades, and a spacious backyard retreat. Step into the light-filled living room, where high ceilings, a charming fireplace with decorative tile, and newer windows with see-through blinds create a warm, open atmosphere.
